item.title: Whose cans are they?: Resident complaints prompt ownership discussion at Willard City Council Meeting

item.title: Brigham City plans to annex 495 acres of city-owned land near airport
item.description: The Brigham City Council has taken the first procedural step toward expanding the city’s boundaries, accepting two annexation petitions during its Jan. 15 meeting that together cover about 501 acres on the city’s west and north sides. The smaller petition involves 5.59 acres near State Route 13 and 2400 West and was submitted by property owner Drew Laing. item.title: Water conditions update
item.description: Utah’s snowpack season had a very strange start with record-breaking warm conditions and poor snow cover.
